THE FILLED FILE IS NEVER COMMITTED. mapping-config.local.json is gitignored.
It carries live tenant uuids for staff and services; those are not secrets in
the credential sense, but they are production identifiers and they have no
reason to be in a public history.
EVERY PLACEHOLDER BELOW IS DELIBERATELY INVALID. The runner hard-fails on an
incomplete mapping BEFORE anything is staged, because a partial mapping does
not crash - it imports a fraction of the diary and reports success over the
rest. Leaving a 00000000-... in place is caught, not silently used.

_README: TWO EXPORTS, ONE PER CLINIC (vendor confirmed 2026-08-25), so each RUN uses
kind:'fixed' with the clinic that delivery belongs to. The clinic is in the
FILENAME, not in any column, which is why the adapter supports both shapes
and hardcodes neither.
Set locationKey to ONE of the entries in knownLocations below, and make sure
it is the clinic THIS delivery came from. Getting it wrong places every
patient in the file at the wrong clinic, and PL-09 scopes reading by it.
Keys are the `terapeuta` strings AS THE VENDOR STORED THEM, observed in the
amostra. They are matched exactly, so spelling and accents matter.
TWO ENTRIES ARE NOT PEOPLE AND NEED AN OWNER RULING before the run:
'Clinica OsteoJP' and 'NESA'. An appointment attributed to a clinic or to a
method is not attributable to a practitioner, and appointments.practitioner_id
is NOT NULL - so these cannot simply be left blank. Either they map to a real
staff member, or those rows go to to_review and are placed by hand.
Keys are the `tipo_servico` strings as the vendor stored them.
appointments.service_id is NULLABLE, so an unmapped type does NOT sink the
appointment - it imports without a service and the runner warns. That is a
deliberate difference from terapeuta, which is NOT NULL and does sink it.
'Diversos' IS A BUCKET, NOT A SERVICE, and mapping it to one would assert
something the source never said. TO-NORMALIZE: decide with the clinic whether
it becomes a real catalogue entry or is left unmapped.
REFERENCE ONLY. The estado table is ratified and lives IN CODE, as
ESTADO_MAP in packages/db/src/migration/sources/fisiozero.ts. It is
reproduced here so this file reads as a complete picture of the run, and it
is NOT read from this file - editing it here changes nothing.
NOTHING MAPS TO 'confirmed'. Confirmation means a patient answered a reminder
WE sent; no vendor row can evidence that.
_estado.marcada: scheduled when inicio is in the FUTURE; when inicio is in the PAST -> cancelled (owner ruling B, 2026-08-25), imported and counted as checks.pastMarcadaCancelled, NOT routed to review
_estado.*: any other value -> to_review, carrying the value
